dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Uniform narrowing observed from the maximum lateral width at the mid-section toward the visible posterior portion of the peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit a smooth contour with minor asymmetrical protrusion on the anatomical right flank.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity light grey baseline across the dorsal plane, indicating a near-mature white pigmentation phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, low-contrast mottling localized near the cranial region and along the peripheral lateral edges.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Soft, diffuse transitions between lighter dorsal areas and slightly darker lateral shading.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, high-contrast dark oval representing the open blowhole at the cranial-dorsal junction.
